reuse.why: Routes every amount site (forecast, rule-action sync, posting, preview, budget template, API, desktop-client views) through the existing getScheduledAmount and builds the approximate tolerance on the existing getApproxNumberThreshold.

duplication.why: Removes the four inline midpoint ternaries and the template's hand copy instead of adding new ones; the worst-case rule exists only in getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: The rule sits in shared/schedules.ts where the helper lives; expectedAmount is added in the api.ts handler by spreading toExternal rather than in scheduleModel.toExternal, which leaves the new APIScheduleListEntity type declared next to a model that does not produce it.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps, though the desktop-client display sites now switch to the planned amount as a side effect of threading op through every caller.

maintainability.why: One definition with one real variation (op) is easy to own; the positional null op in useScheduleEdit and the inverse flag after op make some call sites slightly opaque.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No site keeps or adds its own amount computation; all call getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: Former copies are deleted, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains the op parameter and one op === 'isapprox' branch, both the genuine variation the steps introduce; useScheduleEdit passes null to opt out of the tolerance rather than bypassing the helper.
